Despite (or because of) their success, CIUs now get pushback from Republican attorneys general, police departments who don't like to see their incompetence/corruption exposed, and city officials who fear the lawsuits wrought by exonerations.

We say goodbye to this handsome gentleman today. 

My wife @LilianaSegura adopted Wally 15 years ago. I don't know that any dog and human could be more perfectly suited for one another. Wally was nearly feral when Liliana got him. She spent the next several years . . .

. . . building his confidence and coaxing out the magnificent beast within him. I first met Wally five years into his life, and only got to see the marvelous result -- this loyal, determined, gentle, awkward, wonderfully empathetic fellow. Truly one of the Seven Great Dogs of his time. We will miss him terribly.

I put a comment over in the Bad Place about the VRA. You will not be surprised to learn that I'm now being told drawing a Congressional district around an area that is majority Black to be majority Black is racism but sectioning it off into four majority white districts is just fine.

NEW: Trump diverted >9,100 FBI personnel to work on immigration during the first 9 months of this term, per public records I obtained. He multiplied them by a factor of 23 - from 279 before he took office to >6500 by September. theintercept.com/2026/05/01/f...

Trump is posting QAnon memes so frequently now that nobody even comments on it anymore. What is there to even say at this point? The most powerful man on the planet has severe internet brain worms, and nobody cares.

Lost track of them after this album, but man, it was so good.

Just to be clear, Tennessee is a 60-40 state. Maybe 65-35. Nashville has already been divided up, fed to the suburbs, and has three MAGA reps now. The “flaw” in the current map Trump is referring to is the single remaining Democratic district, Memphis, which is 63% black and voted Harris +25.

Philadelphia reported 39 murders through April which is the fewest reported there since 1963. New York City reported 75 murders through April 26 which is on track to be the fewest murders through April ever reported (previous low was 86 in 2018).

Trump’s net worth has nearly tripled in his second term, reaching $6.5 billion.

His administration is the most brazenly self-enriching in American history.

My @morningjoe-msnow.bsky.social Chart.

So you do not think that dividing up a majority black city and diluting its voters into districts that extend hundreds of miles into overwhelmingly white counties is an effort to rob black people of representation in Congress?
What an evil piece of shit. I cannot wait to take over.

So far, it has cost 50 million to call it the Department of War, with a total estimated cost of 125 million dollars.
